scripts.test: vp test --run packages/backend/src packages/frontend/src packages/frontend/prototypes lint --exclude '**/*.integration.test.ts' --exclude '**/migrations.test.ts'
scripts.test:integration: : ${TEST_DATABASE_URL:?Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a disposable PostgreSQL database} && vp test --run packages/backend/src/migrations.test.ts $(find packages/backend/src -name '*.integration.test.ts') && pnpm --filter @rpg-engine/tests test:api --run && pnpm --filter @rpg-engine/tests test --run
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm --filter @rpg-engine/backend build && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @rpg-engine/frontend test:browser --run && pnpm test:integration
